title: Replace a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence
summary: You can order a replacement pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence if your original licence has been lost, stolen, or destroyed.
intro: If you hold a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence and it has been destroyed, lost or stolen, you can order a replacement at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You must hold a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence that has been destroyed, lost, or stolen.
what_you_need: A written request explaining the reason for replacement

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.

external_links.text: Pawnbroking and secondhand dealers – NSW Fair Trading

internal_links.text: Renew a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence
Restore a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my licence?
faqs.a: You need a written request explaining why the replacement is needed, your name and licence details, and payment.

faqs.q: How do I replace a lost or stolen licence?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre and provide the required information in person.
